newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT plans further expansion in Poland.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT plans further expansion in Poland.

text.p: Dutch paper group KNP BT said on Wednesday it intended to continue its expansion into Central and Eastern European countries.

"We intend to further expand at a rapid pace into Poland and the Czech Republic, in order to become the leading transport packaging maker (in the region). Our ambition is clear," executive board chairman Frank de Wit, told a news conference.
He said KNP BT preferred to acquire existing companies and bring know-how into them, but did not exclude starting up greenfield operations in the region.
He said KNP BT now had two corrugated board plants in Poland and planned at least two more, also to ensure a better geographical coverage.
"We are looking at both possibilities (acquisitions and greenfield operations)," De Wit said.
